meta.name: Made in Heaven
meta.description:
The story of two wedding planners in Delhi, where tradition jostles with modern aspirations against the backdrop of big fat Indian weddings revealing many secrets and lies.

Rated 15 · Ended · First aired 7 Mar 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 47 min
Studio: Excel Entertainment, Tiger Baby · Network: Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9 | S2 7/7

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: All that glitters is gold
videos.overview: Tara Khanna and Karan Mehra have landed the biggest wedding in Delhi. Angad Roshan, heir to the Roshan Cycles empire, is marrying Aliya Saxena, a journalist. For the Roshans, something is definitely amiss. Tara and Karan must investigate who Aliya really is, or there might not be a wedding at all. No better way to start the wedding season.

videos.title: Star struck lovers
videos.overview: Harsimran Mann, a Dubai princess, is marrying Joginder Sethi, of the Sethi Hotel Group. Made In Heaven has planned for Harsimran’s favorite Bollywood superstar Sarfaraz Khan to headline the first night. With a Mann-Sethi business deal on the line, this wedding has a lot more riding on it than meets the eye. And with Sarfaraz in attendance, the bride has nothing but stars in her eyes.

videos.title: It’s never too late
videos.overview: Gayatri Mathur, a sixty-plus widow, is marrying Bijoy Chatterjee, a Bengali architect. It’s a distinctively sweet union that has everyone’s support except the people that matter most - her children. On the flip side, Karan’s college friend Bubbles is getting married to man that Karan knows a bit better than he would have hoped.

videos.title: The price of love
videos.overview: Priyanka Mishra is marrying Vishal Shrivastava, an IAS officer and the plan is to fund the wedding themselves. The Mishras are disappointed that they can’t splurge on their only daughter’s wedding till their in-laws find a way to change that. Can Karan and Tara balance the parents and the kids?

videos.title: A marriage of convenience
videos.overview: Sukhmani Sadana wins a contest that will determine who marries Jeet Gill, a wealthy NRI. The promise of an American life as an American wife is a big deal for a Ludhiana girl. Tara and Karan know that this isn’t a prestigious destination wedding for Made in Heaven, but one must do what is required in the given circumstances. After all, it is what it is.

videos.title: Something old, something new
videos.overview: Geetanjali Sinha, a Wharton graduate, is marrying Nikhil Swarup, a doctor residing in London. A wedding so straightforward couldn’t have come at a better time. That is, of course, until it turns out that Geetanjali is a manglik. Tara and Karan aren’t in the best space to negotiate between superstition and logic.

videos.title: A royal affair
videos.overview: Samar Ranawat, a Rajput prince, is marrying Devyani Singh, a pilot making her the first working woman in the royal household. A lavish celebration of progress and woman empowerment is interrupted when a mehendiwali is sexually assaulted during an event. Tara and Karan need to get the girl justice while making sure the show goes on.

videos.title: Pride and bridezilla
videos.overview: Tarana Ali is getting married and is using the opportunity to make a music video for herself. Her father has gone into debt. On the flip side, the peon at the Made In Heaven office is bailed out by Tara and Karan from taking a loan to fund his daughter’s wedding. Rich or poor, nothing seems to be more important to a man’s ego than how he gets daughter married.

videos.title: The great escape
videos.overview: Political party leader Brajesh Yadav’s daughter, Nutan Yadav is marrying Vishal Singh, a man groomed to be the next prime minister. Everyone knows this wedding is merely a front for the political coalition but when Tara and Karan uncover a harsh truth, they must decide between their principles and their business.

videos.title: Mirror mirror on the wall
videos.overview: A grand colonial-themed wedding is at hand. But when the groom discovers the bride’s attempts at skin lightening, it looks like the marriage is off the table.

videos.title: Beauty and the beast
videos.overview: Anik and Adhira seem very much in love. But what lies beneath Anik’s charm and confidence? And what is the real story behind Adhira’s chipped tooth?

videos.title: And they lived happily ever after
videos.overview: Kriti and Gulshan decide to sacrifice their once-in-a-lifetime kind of love for the sake of their children who are now engaged. But are their children really in love?

videos.title: Love story
videos.overview: A Bollywood wedding in France is destined to have a lot of drama. But is this love story all it’s cracked up to be?

videos.title: The heart skipped a beat
videos.overview: A Dalit Buddhist wedding rankles the traditional notions of the groom’s family while a young boy struggles to come to terms with his mother’s second marriage.

videos.title: Warrior princesses
videos.overview: A woman watches as her husband takes in a second wife while a lesbian couple wonder if a celebration can take place without their family support.

videos.title: A taste of heaven
videos.overview: A couple with a ten-year age difference overcome all familial objections to get together. But are all obstacles surmountable?
